about_the_game:
Russian roulette horror with 2-4 players, featuring a new card ability system for unique strategy and gameplay. Take a seat at the table.

Play Solo Or Co-Op With Friends

Test your luck at the table with classic Russian roulette gameplay featuring unique cards that introduce novel gameplay and strategy. Cards appear in the second round.

Key Features

  • Take turns firing a revolver pistol at the table

  • Unique cards that can change the course of the battle, appearing at round 2

  • Voice chat for added laughs

  • Play Online Or Vs AI

  • Healing card / Airshot card / Revolver spin card 

Unpredictable Rounds:

Every round is unique, with a revolver chambered with a random assortment of live and dummy rounds. Strategy and luck are both your allies, as no two rounds will ever play out the same way.

Take a seat at the Bunny Roulette Table

Test your luck at the bunny table, you'll need it to win the game of classic Russian roulette with a twist!

Tabletop Multiplayer Experience With Up To 4 Friends:

Bunny Roulette supports lobbies of up to four players, and you can also play solo with a play vs AI game mode.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains violent gameplay, bunnies can inflict damage with revolver pistol when aimed at self very dangerous.  Contains killing of bunnies and suicide themes. Frequent Violence and General Mature Content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-760 (4 * 2800); AMD Athlon II X4 645 AM3 (4 * 3100)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 550 Ti (3072 VRAM); Radeon HD 6850 (1024 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 (4 * 3200); AMD FX-4350 (4 * 4200)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 2048 VRAM; Radeon RX 460 4096 VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
